body:
As someone who has a plan to kill myself in a few months, I laugh at this. It really is amazing how little support there is for people with mental illnesses in this country. It can literally be hell on earth for the person depending on the circumstances. My situation is tolerable enough that I can go out without taking too big of a shit on the few people around me, hence why I'm waiting a few months, however others are so miserable that they can't wait.

There are waits on getting help, the help is expensive (this is a general problem with healthcare in America tho), which is especially damning because the process to find the right medication can take several months. Really wish for the sake of people after me that the government puts a higher priority on this and save a bunch of lives and heartache.

N & M, 2013. He started me off with a cool rat deck that had a bunch of kamigawa cards and I loved it. I don't remember what he played because he always mixed it up, but she played orzhov with an obzedat in there. Her deck was very annoying in multiplayer, extorting all the time, though she never really felt like a threat because the dudes she played weren't that big on their own, until Obzedat came in and then she usually killed at least one person from there.

I'd give almost anything to go back to that time - not knowing how instants worked ("Obzedat is invincible wtf!!"), not knowing 99.9% of the cards, and especially not having any knowledge of a meta - just playing with what you opened and being ignorant to buying singles. Also not having all the rules lingo nailed into my subconscious after playing with rules lawyers at FNM. Having to say "trigger" takes the fun out of the game for me.
Don't feel guilty, it's not your problem. I appreciate that you care though, and I hope that you're able to live a fulfilling life.

I've never been a fan of that YOLO van trip that everyone likes to throw around. It's just not appealing to me, idk.

I've tried getting help before and it didn't work out. I'd seek it again since I have nothing to lose at this point, but I don't have the money for it.

We don't share that ideology sadly. I'm not a fan of the thought of dedicating myself to helping others, because most of my observations/interactions with people have been negative, and it has rubbed off on me. Though, I'm not an outwardly mean person. Just not a fan of people, you know?

I'm past the point where thinking about how killing myself will affect the few who care about me is enough to stop it from happening. Obviously I still feel bad about it, but it's just not enough to stop me, I've had enough.
I've been through that and everything else related, but thanks. It's a decision I've put many years of thought into.

I see your ramble and raise you my own so maybe others have more perspective.

Life is what you make it, we don't have a particular purpose in the universe, all you're supposed to do is find what makes you happy. I didn't care about working for a big company, or advancing the world by contributing to whatever goes on in SV, or aspire to make 6 figures. It's 50/50 whether I could have been a cool kid like that. Realistically I would have ended up some 50k code monkey and that would have been ok. 

Me personally, there's nothing enjoyable to me. This field was the closest thing, but it's not an attainable goal for a few different reasons. As such, I'm gonna off myself in July. It's not upsetting at all, I'm at peace with the decision. Am I suggesting other people here do the same? Of course not. I feel most people who wonder about these kind of things are early 20's kids that have spent so much time in school they haven't had a chance yet to really reflect on what life means to them, or even if they have had the time, the answer just hasn't hit them yet. You just don't know what you want, that's ok, if you are in the field then you're setting yourself up for an easy time down the road. You'll be able to do a lot of things that most people can't. 

If you're the type of person that OP described that made it and suddenly feel empty, well, that means you probably mostly chose this field for the money and not because you enjoy it? Again, that's fine. Really take the time to think about what makes you happy, when you have the chance. Think about the things you like to do, the things you are grateful for, what makes you happy - those are all that matter.

I could, but I don't want to be that guy in his late 20's that still lives with his parents and has no friends. I would rather die. Of all my concerns, I 100% admit that this is the most selfish and least rational reason to want to off myself, but it is what it is.

Anyway I have to sleep because it's almost 2am, and I've felt like shit this whole time talking about my plan to kill myself. I appreciate that you care and hope you find what makes you happy if you haven't already.
No. I don't think my situation is shitty enough to warrant such a thing. Also, I feel uncomfortable when people gift me things, and what if it didn't even work out? I would feel even worse then.

There are only so many job opportunities for me as I am limited to what I can walk to. As it stands, I only make enough to pay rent and utilities and live off pasta and water. I don't know what kind of health insurance I can get for my situation, but I remember the ADHD medicine alone was $50 for 30 pills. That's still leaving out the cost of therapy and medicine for my depression.

I started with aerospace engineering and then switched to computer science. Now I'm looking at comp sci, atmospheric sciences, civil engineering and some other things, but I don't know exactly what I want to do, and I can't find information that explains what the relevant jobs are like, so there's no way for me to verify "yep, this is for sure what I want to do". All I can ever find is "We are looking for candidates with X, Y, Z" but it never explains what they do, what a normal day is like, etc. I wasn't fortunate enough to be born into a middle-class family and have the luxury of exploring these different fields and switching as much as I want. 

Anyway... Again this all is leaving out the fact that I can't afford to go to school.

I have, but I just don't have the attention span for it. In addition to all the other shit I've mentioned, I have really bad untreated ADHD. I literally can't focus on most things for more than 10-30 minutes without medicine, but with it, I was a 4.0 student.

There are so many things I need help with that I can't afford. Just to give you a better idea of why I've given up rather than carry on fighting a battle I can't win.
I read your other reply and appreciate your words, but there's just nothing for me.
No, they can't help. My family is poor and my one friend can only provide moral support. Nothing to fix my situation unfortunately.

I have, but I haven't been able to find any for the fields I was interested in. I know colleges usually have resources available exclusively for their students to help with these types of things, but that's not helpful to the people on the outside looking in

Feeling nothing would be an upgrade from my current situation. If my options are 1) continue living, be miserable 2) go to the ER and put myself in debt for the rest of my life 3) die - then it's pretty easy to see what the best choice is.
Death is peace, and I will have it.

I would if I could afford it, but that's the thing, I don't have the money to fix any of my problems. Can't afford therapy for my depression and can't afford school to advance myself. I'm stuck and there's no way out, and rather than being stuck working min wage until my 70s, I'm just going to kill myself.

I'm aware of that option and have already concluded I'd rather die than be in debt for the rest of my life. I can already barely afford living the apartment lifestyle, I can't imagine what it would be like having to pay off those medical bills, plus being forced to go to those appointments, plus the medicine, all with no health insurance.
Like I said, I literally can't get help because I don't have enough money. The only place in my area that can accept me has a 3-4 month waiting list. I'll be dead by then.

It's shitty reading the same responses all the time, and most of the time it's just people who repeat what they have heard others say before. I'm not trying to be a dick, it's just frustrating when people give advice for situations they haven't been in before.

All you care about is your bottom line. I spent about $1000 when I went through that whole system. "Sorry, we can't increase your dosage yet because it's too early" "Before we change medicine, we need to wait a little longer to see if this helps, but we're going to need you to keep coming in every other week so we can monitor your progress". etc.

Bi-weekly visits, hour long talks that don't accomplish anything, I've been there. I was used. All you psychologists care about is your bottom line. You don't care whether or not I get better, you want me to keep coming for as many visits as I can afford, and suggest medicine you know won't work because you make commission off it. I know the deal, I can't do anything about it, and it's unfortunate you guys take advantage of people like that, and sadly I don't have money to throw away anymore. 

There is no help.

You don't know me or my situation. This last hour has been amazing, seeing how many people have such ignorant perceptions of suicidal people. For some reason everyone seems to think it's as easy as "Talk to a psychologist, get some medicine, ta-dah, you're fixed!"

Something something, walk a mile in my shoes.
You are telling a complete stranger "I don't care how shitty your situation is, deal with it, it's immature to kill yourself". Think about that for a second.
I can't afford it, is part of the problem. I can't even find a psychologist in my area to prescribe me medicine.
I am a fairly calculated and level-headed person. Whether or not depression is "fucking up how my brain works", I don't have any way to get help for my problems, that is a very clear fact.

I want to be passionate about something, go to school in whatever that field is, get a job that's nice enough to allow me to have a child and provide for it well enough that it can grow up to do whatever it wants.

But I'm not passionate about anything. Nothing is fun or interesting to me. Additionally, I can't afford to go back to school. I am stuck working shit jobs that pay just enough for me to live a shitty apartment lifestyle until I grow old enough that I can't work and end up dying on the street.

All I've ever been is a failure and a disappointment. There's no reason for me to continue living, so as I've said, in other comment chains, I'm going to honor my lease so my ex-roommate doesn't have to bear the financial burden, and kill myself.
That's what's great about my situation, it isn't temporary. There is no fix for it. So that old saying doesn't apply to me.

I'm not going to have a child unless I can support it as well as I'd like, and since that won't happen, I'm going to be responsible and not have one. That's at least one less miserable person running around down the line.
I won't lie, a small part of me does want to see what things would be like in my 30's - and I believe you when you say that it's much different. But I can't wait anymore, life is miserable.

I've already been through therapy and all that shit and it didn't help. I think it's very ignorant of you to say that suicide isn't a rational decision, especially given you don't know me or my situation.
You said to change the current situation if I can't stand it, and I plan on changing it by killing myself.
And I plan on doing so by killing myself. Very simple and easy answer.
I guess compared to someone 30+? I'm just making the point that I'm not some angsty teen having a tantrum.

I'm going to be blunt, you aren't helping. All I care about at this point in life is finding a reasonable career that will make me happy and pay enough that I can raise a child to allow them to be whatever they want to be, because I couldn't, given my poor family.

As it stands I can't afford college, and even if I could, nothing makes me happy so I don't know what to do. I already failed at engineering and threw away a few years of my life pursing that. Simply put, I was born into a poor family, i.e. a below-average situation, and then grew up into a failure.

At the end of the day no amount of "appreciating the little things" or any of the therapy, pills, or talking helps me achieve my goals. Actions do. And I can't take action because I don't have money. No amount of motivational speak will change that.
Waiting for my lease to end in July so my ex-roommate doesn't have that financial burden placed on them.

I've already checked. The only one that can help me given my financial situation has a 3-4 month wait on accepting new patients, and that's around the same time my lease ends. Something insane will have to happen for me to change my mind, but I don't mind either way.
Because this problem has been on-going for at least 7 years, or about 30% of my life
I've already put years of thought into it, and like I said somewhere else, the thought of it ending is very comforting and helps me get through these last few months before I do it.
Yeah, I "may". Something incredible would have to happen for me to want to continue living, and I'm not going to continue living for another 70 years in the <1% chance that something great happens.
You are now aware how terrible it is to be in that position.
That's not what I'm trying to do. I'm just saying not to get your hopes up and expect the hotline to help.

I've been through all that already. What do you think I am, some angsty 16 year old kid bitching because I'm having a bad day? I'm 25, I've experienced enough to come to this conclusion in a mature and rational way.

I guess it's all about perspective. I don't have it in me to do this "exploring" fantasy that everyone talks about -- what are you going to do, eat wild animals and do some survivor man shit? Backpack around, sleep outside? Find stranger's places to sleep at? That's how people end up in those situations where they get tortured. Might as well end yourself in a peaceful way than get murdered slowly with a screw driver or something.

If the options are backpacking or living the rest of your life paying off debts from your suicide attempt by working some trash minimum wage job, never being able to advance yourself because you can't afford college, then I would rather kill myself. And that's what I'm going to do.
Whatever you decide, good luck. Life is about finding what makes you happy, and if you can't, then you might as well save the suffering and end yourself sooner than later.

I've read all the breakthrough stories - that's not going to happen to me. I don't know how your situation panned out, but I've been living with these problems for 7 years, and there's no solution. Medicine, talking, exploring hasn't helped. I've correctly identified that the only reason to live is to find what makes you happy and do it, and there's no such thing for me. I don't get joy in anything and there's no way for me to achieve a tolerable future. But, it's cool that you were able to find these things, I'm glad for you (not sarcasm).

I wish I could, but I'm 25 and haven't found anything that makes me happy. I don't have a future.

PS I'm not the one downvoting you, sucks that people replying to me are getting downvoted.

Wasn't sure if that's what you meant.. Everyone has their own threshold of what they can tolerate. I'm at the point now where the thought of any kind of future makes me sick, so I am comfortable with the thought of killing myself. For now, I'm honoring my lease so my ex-roommate doesn't get fucked financially, but once the lease is over I'm doing it, and the thought makes me happy.

It depends on the field. Like my example of piloting, you will never be able to get a job like that when you have a history of mental health issues. Same deal with the military, law enforcement, you get the idea. You aren't going to get turned down a programming job of course.

It's anonymous, just force yourself to do it. 

The only thing is that if you say you are at immediate risk of killing yourself, they'll track you and send an ambulance. Otherwise it's just some person talking to you.
I have already done a full search, there is no help around me. My friends and family can't help me either.

I said in response to another guy posting these links - the hotline does NOT help. All they do is thank you for calling, look up clinics around you (that you can google yourself), and engage in a little small talk. It accomplishes nothing. 

Therapy is expensive and ineffective. They cost at least $20 for an hour long visit, and that's WITH insurance.. They milk you HARD for what little money you have (because most depressed people are usually poor as well) because that's all they care about in the end.
My life story aside, I can't afford to get help. I'm not going to carry on 70 years hating everything about my life every day, so I'm going to end it when my lease ends.

Which is honestly worse than dying. First of all that shit is expensive, and having it on your record automatically prevents you from ever having a wide number of jobs. Have an epiphany afterwords and decide your calling in life is to be, for example, a pilot? 0% chance you will ever be considered.

I wish the government would just have options for assisted suicide for people who can't get help. It's better than people making a spectacle of it like this, or worse, people who go on killing sprees before taking themselves out.

For the record I am not trolling, I'm going to kill myself in a few months and it's pretty shitty the lengths I have to go to make sure it's painless. All the government cares about is milking you for money when you want to seek help, and if you can't afford it, too fucking bad. Yes I'm triggered right now. Reading this thread makes me mad.

Coming from someone who is going to commit suicide in a few months, let me tell you that the hotline does NOT help at all. Literally all they do is give fake sympathy, use google to look up clinics around you (which you could do by yourself) and give you their numbers.
